question_text: A villager Itwaari has a plot of land of the shape of a quadrilateral. The Gram Panchayat of the village decided to take over some portion of his plot from one of the corners to construct a Health Centre. Itwaari agrees to the above proposal with the condition that he should be given equal amount of land in lieu of his land adjoining his plot so as to form a triangular plot. Explain how this proposal will be implemented.
answer_text: Let quadrilateral ABCD be the original shape of the field. The proposal may be implemented as follows. Join diagonal BD and draw a line parallel to BD through point A. Let it meet the extended side CD of ABCD at point E. Join BE and AD. Let them intersect each other at O. Then, portion ∆AOB can be cut from the original field so that the new shape of the field will be ∆BCE.

steps.description: Identify the original quadrilateral ABCD.
Draw diagonal BD and a line parallel to BD through point A.
Extend the line to meet side CD at point E.
Join points BE and AD, and find their intersection at point O.
Cut portion ∆AOB from the original field to form the new triangular plot ∆BCE.

final_answer: Thus, the new shape of the field will be ∆BCE, maintaining equal area.

answer_image.description: Diagram illustrating the quadrilateral land and the proposed triangular plot.

difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of geometric properties and area preservation.

Similarly, ∆ACY and ∆ACX lie on the same base AC and are between the same parallels AC and XY. Area (∆ACY) = Area (ACX). From these equations, we obtain Area (∆ADX) = Area (∆ACY).

steps.description: Identify triangles ∆ADX and ∆ACX on the same base AX.
Establish that they lie between the same parallels AB and DC.
Conclude that Area (∆ADX) = Area (∆ACX).
Identify triangles ∆ACY and ∆ACX on the same base AC.
Establish that they lie between the same parallels AC and XY.
Conclude that Area (∆ACY) = Area (ACX).
Combine results to show Area (∆ADX) = Area (∆ACY).

final_answer: Thus, ar (ADX) = ar (ACY).
